templates.title: All Nodes
templates.description: Show all nodes with ALL their properties
templates.query:
MATCH (n)
RETURN n.id as id, n.label as type, n.name as name, 
       n.confidence as confidence, n.source_text as source_text,
       n.created_at as created_at, n.updated_at as updated_at,
       n.valid_from as valid_from, n.valid_until as valid_until,
       n.is_current as is_current, n.canonical_id as canonical_id,
       n.language as language, n.reason as reason
LIMIT 100

templates.title: All Edges
templates.description: Show all edges with ALL their properties
templates.query:
MATCH (a)-[r]->(b)
RETURN r.id as id, a.name as from_node, r.relation_type as relation_type, b.name as to_node,
       r.confidence as confidence, r.source_text as source_text,
       r.created_at as created, r.updated_at as updated,
       r.valid_from as valid_from, r.valid_until as valid_until,
       r.is_current as current, r.reason as reason
LIMIT 100

templates.title: Active Projects
templates.description: Find all active projects and who is working on them
templates.query:
MATCH (p:PERSON)-[:WORKING_ON]->(proj:PROJECT)
WHERE proj.status = "active"
RETURN p.name, proj.name, proj.progress
ORDER BY proj.progress DESC

templates.title: Recent Changes
templates.description: Show nodes created or updated in the last 7 days
templates.query:
MATCH (n)
WHERE n.created_at > "2024-12-24"
   OR n.updated_at > "2024-12-24"
RETURN n.label, n.name, n.created_at, n.updated_at
ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 20

templates.title: Strongest Connections
templates.description: Find the most connected nodes in the graph
templates.query:
MATCH (n)-[r]-(m)
RETURN n.label, n.name, COUNT(r) as connection_count
ORDER BY connection_count DESC
LIMIT 10

templates.title: Goal Dependencies
templates.query:
MATCH (g:GOAL)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dep:GOAL)
RETURN g.name as goal, dep.name as depends_on, g.priority
ORDER BY g.priority DESC

templates.title: Temporal Evolution
templates.description: Track how entities changed over time
templates.query:
MATCH (n)
WHERE n.valid_from IS NOT NULL
RETURN n.label, n.name, n.valid_from, n.valid_until, n.is_current
ORDER BY n.valid_from DESC
LIMIT 20

templates.title: Multi-Hop Paths
templates.description: Find paths between two entities (up to 3 hops)
templates.query:
MATCH path = (start:PERSON {name: "Michael"})-[*1..3]-(end:GOAL)
RETURN start.name, end.name, LENGTH(path) as hops,
       [rel in relationships(path) | type(rel)] as path_types
ORDER BY hops
LIMIT 10

templates.title: Property Aggregation
templates.query:
MATCH (n)
RETURN n.label, 
       COUNT(n) as total,
       AVG(n.confidence) as avg_confidence,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN n.is_current = 1 THEN 1 END) as current_count
ORDER BY total DESC
